Sets all of the Collision Categories that this Arcade Physics Bodywill collide with. You can either pass a single category value, oran array of them.Calling this method will reset all of the collision categories,so only those passed to this method are enabled.If you wish to add a new category to the existing mask, callthe `addCollidesWith` method.If you wish to reset the collision category and mask, callthe `resetCollisionCategory` method.
